run_mnist_training: run the MNIST CNN training script with schedulefree AdamW optimizer and configurable epochs
create_net_model: create a PyTorch CNN model with two conv layers, two dropout layers, and two fully connected layers for MNIST
train_model_schedulefree: train the MNIST model using schedulefree AdamW optimizer with configurable batch size and learning rate
test_model_accuracy: test the trained MNIST model and print average loss and accuracy on the test set
save_trained_model: save the trained MNIST model state dictionary to a file for later loading and inference
